activities.name: Run
activities.description: Run one bounded native process with separate binary streams.
activities.whenToUse: Use Condenser.Process for an already resolved local application path and ordered arguments. Inspect ExitCode and bytes in the completed Result; own any file or network effects of the child. A timeout, byte cap, start or cleanup failure has no Result.

properties.description: Existing absolute application path; no shell or expansion.
Ordered native string array; at most 256 entries of 8192 characters each.
properties.whenToUse: Pass arguments as separate strings, including paths with spaces.

properties.description: Optional byte array of at most 8388608 bytes.
properties.whenToUse: Supply binary stdin; omit to leave stdin unredirected.

properties.description: Required integer from 1 through 30000 including start, IO and exit.
properties.whenToUse: Set the trusted total deadline; cleanup has separate bounded waits.
Bound stdout before decoding or using bytes.
Bound stderr before decoding or logging.

result.description: Completed child exit code, including nonzero.

resultNotes: Validation, start, timeout, cap and cleanup failures return a critical Signal without Result; a completed nonzero child returns Result.
The caller owns child effects and nonzero exit policy.
